title: Advice about grammar statements
description: A Parsimony review offers specific grammar recommendations along the parsimony and restrictiveness axes. It records evidence and limitations, and never decides whether to Apply a change.
helpPage:
# Parsimony review

A Parsimony review gives specific, advisory recommendations about a grammar's parsimony and restrictiveness. Each finding shows whether it comes from grammar structure, Text evidence, or a parser Assessment, and states what that evidence cannot establish.
